entities.summary: EOKA Campaign and Independence, a transformative movement in Cyprus (1955–1960). Emerged from EOKA begins armed campaign for union with Greece and Republic of Cyprus declared independent under the Zurich-London agreements. Catalyzed Constitutional Crisis and Intercommunal Violence.
